accepted_properties: Both entries default to preparation-only and no Git/source access; actual runner requires exact pinned request, subject, helpers, capture, explicit execute and two root leases.
All generated worktrees, local bare remotes, Git objects, mutated fixtures, raw command records and TMP paths are within fresh canonical phases under one root-bound direct OWN child.
Subject main is never executed; only the pinned original top-level pure helpers/build_tree and AST-extracted publisher_state, clean and the unique CAS Git call are used with the synthetic ROOT.
Every phase first proves an actual three-leaf tree/commit, expected-old-value ref update and ordinary push to a local bare remote while historical publisher HEAD/index/train state stays unchanged.

CAS fixed/restored cases require a genuine Git refusal, unchanged race ref and stderr containing both exact observed/expected commit IDs plus expected; withdrawal removes only expected-old argument and must fail the named CAS assertion.

Scope fixed/restored reject one existing fourth product leaf through original build_tree; withdrawal changes the in-memory fixed allowlist by that one leaf, and must fail the named scope assertion after setup succeeds.

Preservation fixed/restored mutate HEAD, index and train_ref separately, require the exact subject refusal, and restore each original state in finally; withdrawal removes only the first clean-state guard and must fail the named aggregate assertion.
Each phase is a fresh Python process and fresh tiny Git fixture, so in-memory withdrawal cannot contaminate restored phases or the original subject file.
Original subject bytes remain untouched, and synthetic policy/schema identities are explicitly not formal acceptance identities.
Original c387 recorder captures each real Git invocation and each phase's full streams, true exit and timeout state.

Runner requires exact 0/1/0 exits for each of three cases; withdrawn exit1 additionally requires exact AssertionError marker and a successful original positive. Setup failure, timeout or unrelated refusal cannot count as a kill.
Git system/global configuration and templates/hooks are isolated for synthetic setup; injected GIT_* variables are removed before synthetic Git commands. Only the explicit local bare remote is used.
Original adopter, native, compiler, real source root, real publisher objects and actual GitHub remote are not executed or modified by these fixtures.
16MiB actual-mount admission and per-phase observed allocated bound are present; full raw failures are retained if exceeded.
limits: No phase was executed by this static review; all nine runtime exits remain UNRUN.
16MiB is a root-admitted synthetic planning/observed bound, not a continuous peak measurement or an OS quota. Root must account for shared OWN commitments separately.
These fixtures validate selected real-Git primitives, not the adopter's full request/schema validation, real-root admission, exact original ledger/architecture peers or actual remote API delivery.
The original subject and reviewed helper pins must be rechecked immediately before execution; any changed bytes invalidate this review.
